OpenAI is launching a ChatGPT experience for teens, describing it as "an experience designed to help teens learn, think critically, deepen their understanding, and use AI with confidence." The teen experience will activate when an OpenAI system estimates a user is between 13 and 17 years old, or when a user self-declares their age.

OpenAI highlights four features that ChatGPT for teens combines:

  • A learning mode that uses guided questions and step-by-step support to help teens master material.
  • New responsible homework prompts that detect when a teen is trying to take shortcuts on assignments and redirect them to learning mode for a step-by-step collaborative problem-solving process.
  • Quizzes and learning visualizations that give teens more ways to practice and test what they know, and help them understand tricky concepts more clearly so they can verify their learning.
  • In addition, a new study session feature lets teens or parents choose time blocks during which learning mode is on by default, helping weave good study habits into their routines.

The ChatGPT teen experience also includes the following safety measures and safeguards:

For teen users, protections are part of the default experience. For users under 18, ChatGPT's teen experience applies age-appropriate safeguards intended to reduce exposure to potentially harmful or developmentally inappropriate content while preserving the ability to learn, create, and explore. [...] This work also builds on the family tools we previously launched with parental controls and notifications. Parents who have linked a teen's account can set quiet hours, manage specific settings, and receive safety notifications in limited high-risk situations. We are adding notifications around eating disorders, as well as limiting the scope of content shared, focusing on moments when offline support may matter most.

OpenAI also details how ChatGPT works for users under 18, including the following well-being measures:

  • A sensitive image upload nudge reminding teens not to share intimate or sensitive images.
  • An onboarding flow built for teens that introduces them to the learning and safety features available from the start.
  • Simple personalization options, like theme colors and voice variations, that help make the experience feel personal without blurring the line between a useful tool and a relationship.
